Fairness.question: How do I know Jev can't take it back?
Fairness.p1: The server calls the real TypeSafe API and uses Jev's returned choice as-is. If the call fails, the round stops — no random stand-in. Your move this round is never sent to Jev.
Fairness.p2: On open, move, model, round number, history digest, and a random salt become a SHA-256 commitment. The browser saves that hash before buttons unlock. Reveal or settle only unseals the original choice — no second AI call. The browser recomputes the hash and records the round only if it matches.
Fairness.p3Title: Want to lift the lid? You can.
Fairness.p3: The lid is a real div. An unrevealed move stays inside the sealed blob and is never written into the page early. Clicking returns the original move, lifts the lid, and marks the round peeked. Peeked rounds still enter Jev's context.
Fairness.p4Title: This is a personal match log.
Fairness.p4: The commitment proves the sealed move didn't change; signed records deter casual edits. It is not an official TypeSafe attestation. Local storage has no cross-device sync and cannot stop developer-tool rollbacks, request replays, or peek-flag bypass, so this is not a competitive leaderboard. Clearing browser data wipes local history — export when you need it.

Errors.keyRequired: Enter a full TypeSafe API Key.
Errors.SETUP_REQUIRED: Server proof secret isn't configured. Contact the site maintainer.
Errors.INVALID_ROUND: This round's proof is invalid or expired — it can't be changed or regenerated. Export your record, then start a new series.
Errors.INVALID_HISTORY: Match record is malformed or over the per-series cap.
Errors.HISTORY_TAMPER: Match record failed verification — it may be edited or missing a round. Export first, then start a new series.
Errors.INVALID_SERIES: Series id is invalid. Refresh the page.
Errors.MISSING_KEY: Enter a valid TypeSafe API Key to begin.
Errors.SERIES_COMPLETE: This series hit 500 rounds. Start a new series — old matches stay local and exportable.
Errors.INVALID_ANALYSIS: Jev returned no valid behavior analysis. Round didn't start — retry.
Errors.INVALID_ANSWER: Jev returned no valid rock, paper, or scissors. Round didn't start — retry.
Errors.PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE: No word from Jev. Network may have timed out — retry shortly. Nothing counted.
Errors.INVALID_KEY: TypeSafe rejected this key. Check the API key and account permissions.
Errors.NO_CREDIT: TypeSafe account balance is low. Top up or switch keys.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: TypeSafe is busy or rate-limited. Wait a moment and retry.
Errors.PROVIDER_ERROR: TypeSafe returned an error ({status}). Round hasn't started — retry later.
Errors.BAD_REQUEST: Request rejected by the server. Check the payload and retry.
Errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: That step didn't finish. Sealed throws are kept — retry.
